description: NBA player props for today's games: the line, our projection, our chance of the over, the market's and the edge in percentage points, live once a game starts. Largest edges first. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NBA game, by the game_id that nba_games returns (an ESPN event id). Today's games when left out.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

stat.description: pts (points), reb (rebounds) or ast (assists). Every stat when left out.
